acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

anchor((bytes32,bytes32)[]).details: This function burns EQTY tokens as payment for anchoring.      Each anchor in the array will emit a separate Anchored event.      The function is optimized for gas efficiency with minimal storage operations.  Requirements: - Caller must have approved this contract to burn their EQTY tokens - Caller must have sufficient EQTY balance for all anchors  Common usage patterns: - Event chains: key = stateHash, value = eventHash - Messages: key = messageHash, value = 0x0

params.anchors: Array of Anchor structs containing key-value pairs to record

constructor.details: EQTY token and fee can be configured later by the owner

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setAnchorFee(uint256).details: Only callable by owner. Emits AnchorFeeUpdated event.

params.newFee: New fee amount in EQTY tokens (wei)

setEqtyToken(address).details: Only callable by owner. Emits EqtyTokenUpdated event.

params.newEqtyToken: New EQTY token address (can be address(0) to disable fees)

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

MAX_ANCHORS_PER_TX().notice: Maximum number of anchors allowed in a single transaction

anchor((bytes32,bytes32)[]).notice: Submit one or more anchors to be recorded on-chain

anchorFee().notice: Fee amount in EQTY tokens per anchor

constructor.notice: Constructor sets the deployer as the owner

eqtyToken().notice: The EQTY token used for fee payments
